name: class
what: the player class that selects class_level, or 0xff

name: command_current
what: current command in a circular list

name: control
what: AI control passed to a think function

name: target
what: target passed to a think's skill action

name: melee
what: initial melee flag for target search

name: monstats
what: monster row used for think parameters

name: flags
what: which fields the record carries (1 | 4 as FUN_0057b420's callers set it)

name: physical
what: the physical field, in 256ths (what Bone Armor takes from)

name: total
what: the record's total after the absorb and the reduction, in 256ths

name: spawn_class_count
what: bound for the AI spawner's class selection

name: skill
what: the Skills row index of the state

name: pool
what: memory pool passed to the AI control allocator

name: expansion
what: the expansion flag, set by FUN_00555230

name: seed
what: the game seed: one step per unit made (FUN_00552df0)

name: unit_lists
what: 10 list heads of {unit, ?, next +8, prev +0xc} nodes

name: x
what: the room's first subtile column, as FUN_0061a010 returns the grid

name: x_copy
what: a second {x, y, w, h} (the oracle gives it the same values)

name: normcode
what: the normal item code returned instead of code when nonzero

name: field_10f
what: the first byte returned by FUN_006286c0

name: field_110
what: the second byte returned by FUN_006286c0

name: teleport
what: the Levels row's Teleport column (0 none, 1 and 2 allowed)

name: size
what: the collision size FUN_006205a0 returns for a missile unit (zero-extended)

name: skill_mode
what: mode for the first monster skill

name: size_y
what: the collision size FUN_006205a0 returns for a monster unit, sign-extended (the field is a signed char)

name: size_y
what: the collision size FUN_006205a0 returns for an object unit (the row's own +0xd4, read raw as a 4-byte int)

name: target_x
what: the dynamic path's ScreenPos.x, GetTargetX/FUN_006489c0 reads it for FUN_00620900

name: target_y
what: the dynamic path's ScreenPos.y, GetTargetY/FUN_006489d0 reads it for FUN_00620900

name: room
what: the room the unit is in

name: collide_mask
what: what it collides with: a player 0x1c09, a monster 0x3c01

name: low
what: low word of the random seed

name: high
what: high word of the random seed

name: pool_stat
what: the stat that holds an absorb state's pool

name: max_stat
what: the stat that holds its maximum

name: state
what: the state the skill turns on

name: minmana
what: Skills.txt minmana (in points: the payment's floor is minmana x 256)

name: manashift
what: Skills.txt manashift: the price is shifted left by it

name: row
what: its Skills.txt record (FUN_00647960 reads +4 / +5 off it)

name: quantity
what: a scroll or tome's count (FUN_00647640: usable above 0)

name: item
what: the charged item's id, -1 for the character's own skill

name: charges
what: an item entry's charges (FUN_00647540: usable above 0)

name: room
what: the room the static unit (object, item, warp) is in

name: screen_x
what: the static unit's screen x FUN_00620900 reads for types 2, 4 and 5

name: screen_y
what: the static unit's screen y FUN_00620900 reads for types 2, 4 and 5

name: x
what: object or item unit's x coordinate

name: y
what: object or item unit's y coordinate

name: type
what: 0 player, 1 monster, 2 object, 3 missile, 4 item, 5 warp

name: id
what: unit ID used in a minion list

name: data
what: type-specific data; item data for type 4

name: seed_init
what: the seed's low word when made

name: seq
what: the sequence playing (FUN_00621260); 0: FUN_00623e00 steps anim_pos instead

name: seq_pos
what: the sequence position, 256ths of a row

name: seq_rate
what: added to seq_pos each step, 0x100 at the start

name: anim_rate
what: 256 = a frame a tick; IAS in it

name: events
what: the head of its event list (FUN_005c0c30)

name: struck_by
what: who last struck it (FUN_00621d50 from FUN_0057c6c0)

name: hit_class
what: the last hit's class: the impact its GH / KB / DT plays

name: unit_list
what: which of game +0x10f8's lists holds it, 0xb none
